exam: 2021年6月 第2套 · 仔细阅读 P2
title: Success was once defined as being able to stay at a company …

sents.en: Success was once defined as being able to stay at a company for a long time and move up the corporate ladder.
sents.cn: 成功曾经被定义为：能在一家公司待很久，并沿着公司阶梯往上爬。

sents.en: The goal was to reach the top, accumulate wealth and retire to a life of ease.
sents.cn: 目标是爬到顶端、积累财富，然后退休过上安逸的生活。

sents.en: My father is a successful senior executive. In 35 years, he worked for only three companies.
sents.cn: 我父亲是一位成功的高管，35年里只待过三家公司。

sents.en: When I started my career, things were already different.
sents.cn: 当我开始职业生涯时，情况已经不同了。

sents.en: If you weren't changing companies every three or four years, you simply weren't getting ahead in your career.
sents.cn: 如果你不是每三四年就换一次公司，就根本算不上在事业上有所进取。

sents.en: But back then, if you were a consultant or freelancer, people would wonder what was wrong with you. They would assume you had problems getting a job.
sents.cn: 但在那时，如果你是个顾问或自由职业者，人们会怀疑你出了什么问题，认为你找工作有困难。

sents.en: Today, consulting or freelancing for five businesses at the same time is a badge of honor. It shows how valuable an individual is.
sents.cn: 如今，同时为五家企业做咨询或自由职业，是一种荣誉勋章，它显示了一个人的价值。

sents.en: Many companies now look to these "ultimate professionals" to solve problems their full-time teams can't. Or they save money by hiring "top-tier experts" only for particular projects.
sents.cn: 许多公司现在求助于这些"终极专业人士"来解决全职团队解决不了的问题，或者只在特定项目上聘用"顶尖专家"以节省开支

sents.en: Working at home or in cafes, starting businesses of their own, and even launching business ventures that eventually may fail, all indicate "initiative," "creativity," and "adaptability," which are desirable qualities in today's workplace.
sents.cn: 在家或在咖啡馆工作、创办自己的企业、甚至发起最终可能失败的商业冒险，这些都体现了"主动性""创造力"和"适应性"——这正是当今职场中受欢迎的素质。

sents.en: Most important, there is a growing recognition that people who balance work and play, and who work at what they are passionate about, are more focused and productive, delivering greater value to their clients.
sents.cn: 最重要的是，越来越多的人认识到，那些平衡工作与娱乐、并从事自己热爱之事的人，会更专注、更高效，为客户创造更大价值。

sents.en: They are artists, writers, programmers, providers of office services and career advice.
sents.cn: 他们是艺术家、作家、程序员、办公服务提供者以及职业顾问。

sents.en: What's needed now is a marketplace platform specifically designed to bring freelancers and clients together.
sents.cn: 现在需要的是一个专门设计的自由职业者与客户对接的市场平台。

sents.en: Such platforms then become a place to feature the most experienced, professional, and creative talent.
sents.cn: 这类平台进而成为一个展示最有经验、最专业、最具创造力人才的地方；

sents.en: This is where they conduct business, where a sense of community reinforces the culture and values of the gig economy, and where success is rewarded with good reviews that encourage more business.
sents.cn: 他们在这里做生意，在这里社区感强化了零工经济（gigeconomy）的文化与价值观，在这里成功会得到好评的奖赏，从而带来更多生意。

sents.en: Slowly but surely, these platforms create a bridge between traditional enterprises and this emerging economy.
sents.cn: 缓慢但确定地，这些平台在传统企业与这一新兴经济之间架起了一座桥梁。

sents.en: Perhaps more important, as the global economy continues to be disrupted by technology and other massive change, the gig economy will itself become an engine of economic and social transformation.
sents.cn: 或许更重要的是，随着全球经济持续受到技术和其他巨大变革的冲击，零工经济本身将成为经济与社会变革的引擎。
